        "The complete owned one-file diff moves delayed-QUIT recovery out of _sendCommand and into connect.         "SMTP stream completion clears reuse for at least 100 recipients or an enabled message-per-connection limit, while LMTP retains its separate response handling. A successful reusable SMTP completion starts the delay timer; expiry clears _reuseConnection then sends QUIT.         "The actual owned and accepted expression this.socket.onclose = this._onClose(false) calls the arrow handler immediately. It is not a deferred wrapper or a handler factory. If the call returns normally, its result is undefined because _onClose has no explicit return. False skips _free but does not skip logging, a possible _onAuthFailed call, or later accepted timer cleanup. This is a bounded source/comment mismatch, not a reproduced hang, reentrancy failure or proof about the host event-handler setter.",
        "The direct _free/onFree chain explains the comment's concern: _free marks a client free, optionally sends QUIT and calls onFree; SmtpServer returns that client to its free pool and wakes a queued send.
